known.proj4rs: differences only at the poles, where PROJ's own Newton iteration stops early (PROJ x = -112 m at lon -180 lat -90, proj4rs 0).
PROJ (since 9.8) uses the ellipsoidal form (EPSG method 1028), proj4rs the spherical form with radius a.
proj4rs ellipsoidal inverse returns NaN for the south pole with lat_0=-42.
proj4rs inverse returns NaN at the map edge, lon +-180 lat +-60.
inverse 6.6e-6 deg at the poles only; elsewhere within 1.5e-14 deg.

projections.why: spherical tmerc with lat_0, and at the equator (PROJ bc0c9f3e, 2020; ca23885d, 2026-02)
aeqd far from the centre, up to the antipode (PROJ af3e08bf, 2026-07)
